name: Solo violin for a wedding ceremony: the Andante from Bach's Sonata No. 2
seoTitle: Solo violin for a wedding ceremony: Bach's Andante
description: This is the Andante from Bach's second sonata for solo violin, played by one violinist. It's a lovely choice for the prelude or the processional at a wedding.
more: Strings can play every part of a wedding ceremony, from the prelude to the recessional, and the musicians watch the aisle so the processional can last as long as the walk does. The same players can stay on for your cocktail hour and play songs by Coldplay, the Beatles and Taylor Swift.
